content.text: Please cancel order A-4471 and email the customer to confirm.

request.system:
You are an order support assistant. You may use only the tools provided.
If none of them can do what is asked, say so.

tools.description: Return the current status and history of one order.
tools.name: lookup_order

tools.description: Refund an order. Moves money and cannot be undone.
tools.name: issue_refund

tools.description: Search the customer policy handbook for a phrase.
tools.name: search_policy

response.text:
I can't do either of those. My tools can't cancel an order or send emails.

**What I can do:**
- **Look up order A-4471** to see its current status and history, so you can tell whether it can still be canceled.
- **Search the policy handbook** for the cancellation rules, such as time limits or what to do if the order has already shipped.
- **Issue a refund** for the order. This isn't the same as canceling it: a refund moves money and can't be undone, so I'd only do it if you confirm it's what you want and give me the amount.

To get the order canceled and the customer emailed, you'll need your order management system and email tool, or a team member who has access to them. Do you want me to look up the order and the cancellation policy first?
